prompts: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless tileable albedo texture for the underwater river and lake bed of a 3D nature exploration game. Square top-down orthographic material scan, no perspective. Pale olive-beige sand and silt with scattered small smooth pebbles and subtle patches of green submerged moss. Broad readable shapes, gentle low contrast, not noisy, natural irregular pebble sizes. Neutral diffuse illumination, no water surface, no caustics painted in, no horizon, no text, no border, seamless on four edges.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent cutout sprite of a natural freshwater underwater plant for a 3D exploration game. A small upright fan of 7 long soft green ribbon leaves growing from one compact root tuft, whole plant visible, front view, botanical realism, gracefully curved and lightly translucent olive green leaves, no pot, no water surface, no bubbles, no scenery, no shadow, no text. Isolated on a truly transparent background.

Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: transparent inventory icon for a nature survival game. One handcrafted brass and dark forest-green handheld flashlight, clean three quarter view with the handle bottom-left and lens top-right. Entire object visible, warm aged brass rim, knurled green handle, small switch, glass lens, realistic polished game asset, clear readable silhouette. No hand, no light beam, no lettering, no border, no background, isolated on true transparency.
